item_title: Kasuwannin Dijital na Yawa a Birtaniya: Gilts Tokenised, Sasantawa, da Sabon Matsayin Zakara
excerpt: Matsayin Zakara na Kasuwannin Dijital na Yawa na Birtaniya yana mai da gilts da aka mai da su zuwa tokens, sasantawa ta DLT, da kuɗin yawa na dijital zuwa aikin ƙarfin gasa na ƙasa. Tambayar dabaru ta 2026 ga bankuna ita ce horon zane — wane kadarorin tokenised ke kan wace dandali, yadda ake nuna shaidar haɗarin sasantawa, da kuma yadda za a kare matsayin yawa na City of London akan Singapore, Switzerland, da Frankfurt.
twitter_description: Tsarin kasuwannin dijital na yawa na Birtaniya 2026 — Chris Woolard, gilts tokenised, sarrafa sasantawa ta atomatik, ajiyar tokenised, motsi na garantii, da daidaitawar jama'a-da-masu zaman kansu.
subtitle: Kasuwannin yawa tokenised suna ƙaura daga gwaji zuwa daidaitawar jama'a-da-masu zaman kansu. Birtaniya ta ƙirƙiri matsayin zakara saboda gwaje-gwajen ware ba su isa ba.
